entries.title: Ephesians 3:1
segments: For this cause, I, Paul, am the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you nations,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:2
segments: if you have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given to me toward you,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:3
segments: that by revelation He made known to me the mystery (as I wrote before in few words,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:4
segments: by which, when you read, you may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

entries.title: Ephesians 3:5
segments: which in other ages was not made known to the sons of men, as it is now revealed to His holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:6
segments: that the nations should be fellow heirs, and of the same body, and partaker of His promise in Christ through the gospel.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:7
segments: Of this [gospel] I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given to me by the effectual working of His power.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:8
segments: This grace is given to me ([who am] less than the least of all saints) to preach the gospel of the unsearchable riches of Christ among the nations,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:9
segments: and to bring to light what [is] the fellowship of the mystery which from eternity has been hidden in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:10
segments: so that now to the rulers and powers in the heavenlies might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:11
segments: according to the eternal purpose which He purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:12
segments: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence through His faith.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:13
segments: For this reason I desire that you faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:14
segments: For this cause I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:15
segments: of whom the whole family in Heaven and earth is named,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:16
segments: that He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with might by His Spirit in the inner man;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:17
segments: that Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:18
segments: may be able to comprehend with all saints what [is] the breadth and length and depth and height,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:19
segments: and to know the love of Christ which passes knowledge, that you might be filled with all the fullness of God.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:20
segments: Now to Him who is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:21
segments: to Him [be] glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, forever. Amen.
